news.title: IT Shares Rally: HCLTech, Tech Mahindra, TCS Lead Tech Stocks Surge Amid Global Market Rout
news.summary: IT stocks extended their gains after HCLTech's September-quarter results beat expectations. The Nifty IT index rose 2.06% to 30,793.15, while HCLTech, Tech Mahindra, and TCS advanced as investors assessed earnings momentum and global technology trends.

news.title: IT Stocks Rally For Fourth Day: Why Are Infosys, TCS, Tech Mahindra Shares Rising? Know Key Reasons
news.summary: The Nifty IT index surges 3.39% to 31,761.35 in morning trade, emerging as the biggest driver of the domestic market's recovery.

news.title: Mcap of nine of top-10 most valued firms surges by ₹3.65 trn, TCS shines
news.summary: Last week, the BSE benchmark Sensex surged 2,256.94 points, or 3.11 per cent, and the NSE Nifty jumped 625.7 points, or 2.77 per cent

news.title: Market recap: Top-10 firms add Rs 3.65 lakh crore in mcap; TCS leads the gains
news.summary: A strong week in the stock market added Rs 3.65 lakh crore to the combined market value of nine of India’s top-10 most valued firms. TCS led the gains, followed by Bharti Airtel and Infosys.
